scope: Bounded retrospective retrieval and decision test over selected historical records; not independent semantic truth, general efficacy or a population estimate.
instructions: Cite source paths or record names. Separate observations from claims; identify missing evidence. Equivalent defensible decisions are accepted.

questions.task: Should we replace current SkillForge with the experiment-design revision, or the short practical control, based on the November 6 Fabric comparison? Give the decision, results and smallest informative next test.

A release note says the focused-activation and operational-efficiency drafts are still uninstalled and must not be integrated. Is that the latest recorded deployment decision? Reconcile it with the later integration entry without upgrading the benefit claim.

Can we cite the real Prompting focused-context comparison as proof GenerateAlternatives improved loading, now that focused activation was repaired? Separate original exposure, repaired exposure and measured benefit.

An audit failed the experiment-design baseline for not loading PlanChange; operational-efficiency logs also show runner and completion-checker errors. Should these count as failed target outcomes? Explain the validation corrections and completed outcomes.

Retrieval-continuation subjects saw two historical authored targets and ran local checks. Can we assign the better target to a historical selector arm and credit retrieved lessons for the gain? Identify missing evidence, what identical packets imply and whether unchanged repeats are justified.
